title: refactor(rest): move registerFormEndpoints into form-routes.ts (#23050 slice 11)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 11 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slices 3–10's shape (slice 10: PR #23990). The body of `RestServer#registerFormEndpoints` — the public (anonymous) form doors, `GET {basePath}/forms/:slug` and `POST {basePath}/forms/:slug/submit` — moves to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`. The route table, the ordered registrations, the published `dist/*.d.ts` and both bundles' export lists are byte-identical. Every handler's source is identical except the resolve door's, which differs by the two ruled receiver tokens alone (below).

`rest-server.ts` goes from 9,915 to 9,493 lines (base `fd0e72abc`). #23050 stays open for the later slices (CRUD, `/meta`).

**`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`: seat ruling A (`6225503839`) and its `formViews` amendment are applied.** `form.sections` and `form.sharing` cite `form-routes.ts`; `formViews` cites `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts#anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`, the code on the read path that names the key. The quoted code is left as it stands. `check:liveness` exits 0 (`734 pair(s) asked, 733 anchored, 1 exempt`). Both edits are declared on `domain:spec`'s #6017 (`6225495254`, amended `6225900470`).

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API with a type checker, symbol-resolved, base `fd0e72abc`): `registerFormEndpoints` (JSDoc `:9048`, method `:9083`–`:9528`, body `:9084`–`:9527`, 444 lines).

| kind | member | reads | class declaration |
|---|---|---|---|
| method | `resolveProtocol` | 3 (`:9149`, `:9230`, `:9489`) | `:2371`, private async |
| method | `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` | 1 (`:9151`) | `:8973`, private async |
| method | `readFormObjectDefinitions` | 1 (`:9170`) | `:8997`, private async |
| field | `routeManager` | 2, the two `register` calls (`:9177`, `:9382`) | `:1993`, private |
| method | `resolveI18nService` | 1 (`:9269`) | `:2390`, private async |
| method | `buildTranslationBundle` | 1 (`:9270`) | `:3881`, private |
| method | `extractLocale` | 1 (`:9271`) | `:3932`, private |
| static | `translateOptionsFor` | 2, as `RestServer.translateOptionsFor(…)` (`:9281`, `:9312`) | `:3978`, private static |
| method | `packagedObjectBase` | 2 (`:9282`, `:9313`) | `:3909`, private |

The body has no bare `this`, no element access on `this`, no `this` alias and no `function` keyword. The seat's text count (the same eight instance members with the same counts, plus the two static accesses) is confirmed; `this.resolveI…` is `resolveI18nService`.

**Control walk** (the same walker, same base): `anonymousFormIntakeWarnings` (`:9017`) reads `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` and `readFormObjectDefinitions` once each, and the `registerEmailEndpoints` stub (`:8952`) reads `emailServiceProvider`, `routeManager`, `resolveExecCtx` and `enforceAuth` once each — slice 8's host literal. Both match their source.

**Module-level reads** (the same walk), every one an import; no module-level declaration of `rest-server.ts` is read, so no `export` was added anywhere:

- `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`, `anonymousFormIntakePosture`, `anonymousFormIntakeUnavailability`, `anonymousFormObjectName` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), `GetMetaItemsRequest`, `CreateDataRequest` (types, `@objectstack/spec/api`), `mapDataError` (`./error-response.js`), `logError` (`./log.js`): still read elsewhere in `rest-server.ts`, so their imports stay and the module imports the same names from the same modules.
- `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`, `PUBLIC_FORM_SERVER_MANAGED_FIELDS` and `isExpectedRouteError`: read ONLY by this body (the import line was their one other occurrence). Their import names moved with the body, leaving a pointer comment each in `rest-server.ts`'s import block, as slices 5–7 and 10 did.
- `TransportScopedMetaRequest` (type): imported from `ui-routes.ts`, as `rest-server.ts` imports it — slice 10's seat ruling A (`6220753007`). Not moved, not copied.
- `ServerScopedDataRequest` (type): imported from `data-action-routes.ts`, where slice 1 moved it, as `rest-server.ts` imports it.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** `FormRouteHost` (9 members) lists exactly the members the body reads, in the order it first reads them, each typed `RestServer['m']` — and the static as `(typeof RestServer)['translateOptionsFor']`, as slice 7 typed `overlayDocumentationInfo`. The class keeps the private method with its name, docblock and position (JSDoc + signature, base `:9048`–`:9083` against head `:9053`–`:9088`, diff to 0). Its body is the host literal plus `registerFormEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`; the static as `(...a) => RestServer.translateOptionsFor(...a)`. The call site in `registerRoutes`' `registerForBase` (`this.registerFormEndpoints(bp);`, base `:4782`, head `:4787`, under no switch) is unchanged: `registerRoutes` (75 lines) diffs to 0 between base and head; the call moved 5 lines only because of the import block above it.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (two `register` calls, top-level statements of the body) | its one swap (`:5151`/`:5155` at head) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |

No other field is read, and no provider field: the protocol, the tenancy service, the object definitions, the i18n service, its bundle and locale, and the packaged base are each resolved per request by a METHOD, so no getter is owed and the provider ruling (`6215084478`) has nothing to apply to.

**The `static` exception (`6205442867`), its two tokens:** `RestServer.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale)` at base `:9281` (the object schema's translation) and `:9312` (the section headings' translation) are now `this.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale)` at `form-routes.ts` `:307` and `:338`. `translateOptionsFor` is a `private static` whose whole body is `return metaReadGate.metaTranslateOptions(i18n, locale);`: it reads no `this` and nothing but its two arguments, so its behaviour does not depend on its receiver (assumption 2, confirmed). No other token changed.

**Route switches (assumption 4):** the registrar has no switch of its own — `registerForBase` calls it unconditionally, and `RestServerConfig` declares no `api.enable*` flag or forms config for it — so no tenth configuration exists to add. Slice 10's nine configurations are used.

**Late binding, measured** (a one-off vitest file, copied in, run under the verify lock, deleted; not committed). A source `RestServer` gets the seven instance methods planted BEFORE `registerRoutes()` and the class static replaced; both doors are driven. Then seven new methods are planted and the static replaced again AFTER registration, and both doors are driven again. Each records its call.

- **Head:** `MEASURE before: GET 200 POST 201 {"id":"rec_early"} | order early:proto,early:tenancy,early:objects,early:proto,early:i18n,early:bundle,early:locale,early:opts,early:packaged,early:opts,early:packaged,early:proto,early:tenancy,early:objects,early:proto` and `MEASURE after: GET 200 POST 201 {"id":"rec_late"} | order late:proto,…,late:opts,late:packaged,late:opts,late:packaged,… | early calls after re-plant 0`, `Tests 1 passed (1)`. Every member, the static included, is reached at request time.
- **Ablation A** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the host literal's `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` closure replaced by `this.resolveAnonymousFormTenancy.bind(this)` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7958e3cf728f` → `e7a647bd6557`): `late:tenancy` never runs, the early member is called twice more, `Tests 1 failed (1)`. Restored by the tool: blob `7958e3cf728f` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation B:** the static's closure replaced by `RestServer.translateOptionsFor` read at registration (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7958e3cf728f` → `c8a0d8f605b8`): `late:opts` never runs, the early static is called twice more, `Tests 1 failed (1)`. Restored, blob equals `HEAD`, diff empty.
- **Base leg:** the base `rest-server.ts` (blob `b429a90b19d3`) put in the tree under a trap gave the same two `MEASURE` lines, `Tests 1 passed (1)`; restored with `git checkout HEAD`, blob and diff proof.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved body:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 9084–9527, one 4-space indent removed, against `form-routes.ts` lines 110–553: `diff` reports exactly the two receiver lines (body lines 198 and 229); with `this.translateOptionsFor(` mapped back to `RestServer.translateOptionsFor(`, `diff` exits 0 over all 444 lines. Every non-empty line of the range carries the method indent, no line has trailing whitespace, and the two lines with an odd backtick count are `//` comment lines (inline code wrapped across them), so no template literal spans the cut.
- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`, built at base `fd0e72abc` before any edit and at the re-point head `de5848dae`, are both sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` (the value slice 10 reported). The head bundles carry a head-only marker (`registerFormEndpoints.call`: 1 hit in each of `index.js` and `index.cjs`, 0 at base), so the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source. `src/index.ts` is untouched.
- **Export lists:** the base and head ESM and CJS bundles each load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…` on all four). No form-module name is among them.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol answering every member, dumped under nine configs: default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; both off under scoped-optional; `enableSearch: false` under scoped-optional; `enableUi: false` under scoped-optional. Each dump holds `getRoutes()` (functions as arity), the ordered server registration calls, a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source, and that source.
  - Route counts 75 / 150 / 75 / 75 / 73 / 73 / 142 / 148 / 148 — slice 10's — with 2 or 4 form doors each. A second base run was identical to the first.
  - `routes.json` and `calls.json` are byte-identical between base and head in all nine configs.
  - Handler digests differ in exactly the resolve door, `GET …/forms/:slug`, once per mounted base (13 handlers over the nine configs), and in each of them the head source equals base once `this.translateOptionsFor(` is mapped back to `RestServer.translateOptionsFor(` (13 of 13). The submit door's digest is identical everywhere.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control added one character to the moved resolve handler (`'[REST] Public form resolve error:'` → `'…error:!'`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`; anchor 1 → 0, blob `464bbaa4d12c` → `9ec2ba34d8cf`). Routes and calls were unchanged in all nine configs, and the handler digests moved in exactly the resolve door of each mounted base (1 or 2 per config) and nowhere else. Restored: blob `464bbaa4d12c` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
